sections.label: Cleaners clear 30,000kg trash
sections.summary: The organiser mobilised 300 cleaners to clear 30,000 kilogrammes of trash.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for the Environment and Water Resources (Mr Masagos Zulkifli B M M)
sentences.text: The organiser subsequently mobilised 300 cleaners to ensure that 30,000 kilogrammes worth of trash was cleared up.

sections.label: Littering tickets and cleaning costs
sections.summary: NEA issued over 26,000 littering tickets last year, and up to $120 million yearly is spent cleaning public areas.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for the Environment and Water Resources (Mr Masagos Zulkifli B M M)
sentences.text: Last year, NEA issued more than 26,000 tickets to littering offenders, 32% more than previous years and the highest in six years.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for the Environment and Water Resources (Mr Masagos Zulkifli B M M)
sentences.text: In addition, we are expending significant resources to keep public areas clean – as much as $120 million each year is spent on cleaning public areas with some hotspots cleaned every two hours.

sections.label: NEA Community Volunteer programme
sections.summary: Since 2013, NEA's Community Volunteer programme has attracted over 340 individuals to educate others about public cleanliness.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for the Environment and Water Resources (Mr Masagos Zulkifli B M M)
sentences.text: Since the launch of NEA's Community Volunteer (CV) programme in 2013, NEA's CV programme has been successful in attracting more than 340 passionate individuals from various non-Government organisations to step forward as CVs to help us educate others about public cleanliness and nudge those observed littering to bin their litter instead.

sections.label: Auxiliary officer information disclosure limits
sections.summary: Clause 5(i) amends the NEA Act to prohibit auxiliary officers from disclosing certain information obtained in their duties, except in certain circumstances.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for the Environment and Water Resources (Mr Masagos Zulkifli B M M)
sentences.text: As auxiliary officers may obtain sensitive information in the course of their duties, clause 5(i) amends section 47(1)(a) of the NEA Act to prohibit an auxiliary officer from disclosing certain information obtained in the course of his or her duties, except in certain circumstances, such as when he or she is lawfully required to do so.

sections.label: APOs as authorised officers
sections.summary: Clauses 2(b) and 4(b) amend the EPHA and CVPA to enable APOs to be appointed as authorised officers.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for the Environment and Water Resources (Mr Masagos Zulkifli B M M)
sentences.text: Clauses 2(b) and 4(b) will amend the EPHA and CVPA to enable these APOs to be appointed as "authorised officers" for the administration of the EPHA and CVPA.

sections.label: NEA officer photographing offence scenes
sections.summary: Clause 5(d) to 5(g) amends the NEA Act to clarify that an NEA officer can photograph or record the scene of an offence.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for the Environment and Water Resources (Mr Masagos Zulkifli B M M)
sentences.text: Clause 5(d) to 5(g) amends section 42 of the NEA Act mainly to make it clear that an NEA officer can photograph or record the scene of an offence under the NEA Act or any environmental written laws administered by NEA.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for the Environment and Water Resources (Mr Masagos Zulkifli B M M)
sentences.text: NEA will take action against irresponsible environmental offenders and ensure high cleaning standards but keeping Singapore clean requires everyone to play an active role.

sections.label: Community Volunteers scheme eligibility
sections.summary: Only members of four selected environmental-related societies or councils could be appointed as Community Volunteers, though Singapore has at least 44 registered environmental-related NGOs.

sentences.speaker: Er Dr Lee Bee Wah (Nee Soon)
sentences.text: This has been a good scheme to encourage responsibility and ownership for the environment.

sentences.speaker: Er Dr Lee Bee Wah (Nee Soon)
sentences.text: However, under the existing scheme, only members of selected environmental-related societies or councils could be appointed as Community Volunteers (CVs).

sentences.speaker: Er Dr Lee Bee Wah (Nee Soon)
sentences.text: To my understanding, the number of these groups currently stands at four.

sentences.speaker: Er Dr Lee Bee Wah (Nee Soon)
sentences.text: In Singapore, we have at least 44 registered environmental-related NGOs.

sections.label: School students daily cleaning
sections.summary: The Education Minister announced that school students will do daily cleaning, implemented in all schools by the end of 2016.

sentences.speaker: Er Dr Lee Bee Wah (Nee Soon)
sentences.text: Education, coupled with efficient and effective enforcement, is the way forward.

sentences.speaker: Er Dr Lee Bee Wah (Nee Soon)
sentences.text: That is why I am very happy to hear the Education Minister announce last week that school students will do the daily cleaning and it will be implemented in all schools by the end of 2016.

sections.label: Expanding Community Volunteers scheme goals
sections.summary: Expanding the CV scheme should lead to long-term plans for the masses, aiming for a volunteering society and a motivated public.

sentences.speaker: Er Dr Lee Bee Wah (Nee Soon)
sentences.text: The eventual goal of expanding the CV scheme should lead to long-term plans to further this to the masses.

sentences.speaker: Er Dr Lee Bee Wah (Nee Soon)
sentences.text: Ultimately, this scheme will, hopefully, pave the path to two goals: a society that supports volunteering and civic engagement and a nation where the general public feels motivated to fight for their rights to a healthy, clean and green living environment and not depend on a large army of cleaners.

sentences.speaker: Er Dr Lee Bee Wah (Nee Soon)
sentences.text: When I mentioned "large army of cleaners", in Taipei, there are three million people and they have 5,000 cleaners.

sentences.speaker: Er Dr Lee Bee Wah (Nee Soon)
sentences.text: We have five million people in Singapore; we have 70,000 cleaners.

sections.label: Volunteer enforcement powers of arrest
sections.summary: Clause 5 allows auxiliary officers who may be volunteers, but the Bill extends volunteers' powers to arrest, search and seizure.

sentences.speaker: Mr Pritam Singh (Aljunied)
sentences.text: Clause 5 of the amendment allows for the appointment of auxiliary officers who may be volunteers with potentially wide-ranging powers to enforce the Act.

sentences.speaker: Mr Pritam Singh (Aljunied)
sentences.text: However, this Bill extends the powers of volunteers to include powers of arrest including search and seizure as determined by the Chief Executive of NEA.

sentences.speaker: Mr Pritam Singh (Aljunied)
sentences.text: In fact, certain extreme powers such as forced entry, search and seizure and arrest should not be given to volunteers under any circumstances at all but only to NEA officers and auxiliary officers who are subject to the organisational discipline and whose careers are tied to the adherence of these norms.

sections.label: Payment of volunteers
sections.summary: The passage asks whether volunteers under these amendments will be paid.

sentences.speaker: Mr Pritam Singh (Aljunied)
sentences.text: Will our volunteers under these amendments be paid?

sections.label: Risk to multi-racial society
sections.summary: If Parliament is not apprised of how enforcement powers are scoped, the Bill risks unintended consequences harming a harmonious multi-racial society.

sentences.speaker: Mr Pritam Singh (Aljunied)
sentences.text: If Parliament is not apprised of how these enforcement powers under this Bill are scoped, there is a real risk that this Bill will become a victim of unintended consequences; consequences that can irreparably harm a harmonious multi-racial society.

sections.label: Littering fines and Town Council forums
sections.summary: The Workers' Party recommends a Select Committee review, citing no institutional forums in Opposition Town Councils and rising littering fines and corrective work orders.

sentences.speaker: Mr Pritam Singh (Aljunied)
sentences.text: Would there be regular meetings chaired by NEA for the Town Council to share information on problem spots as it would have a better feel of the frequently littered areas and common areas which are potential dengue hotspots?

sentences.speaker: Mr Pritam Singh (Aljunied)
sentences.text: This is relevant as there are currently no institutional forums like the monthly Citizens' Consultative Committee (CCC) meetings for the PA GROs and Town Council representatives to meet in an Opposition Town Council, a state of affairs that is compounded by the fact that PA GROs like the RCs are averse to proactively partnering Opposition Town Councils to deliver outcomes to the community at large.

sentences.speaker: Mr Pritam Singh (Aljunied)
sentences.text: Therefore, the Workers' Party recommends that this Bill be committed to a Select Committee for review.

sentences.speaker: Mr Pritam Singh (Aljunied)
sentences.text: Otherwise, we will not be able to support the Bill in its current form.

sentences.speaker: Mr Gan Thiam Poh (Ang Mo Kio)
sentences.text: Last year alone, the number of littering fines hit a six-year high of over 26,000.

sentences.speaker: Mr Gan Thiam Poh (Ang Mo Kio)
sentences.text: This was a huge 32% increase over 2014.

sentences.speaker: Mr Gan Thiam Poh (Ang Mo Kio)
sentences.text: The number of corrective work orders for littering had more than doubled from 688 in 2014 to 1,300 last year.

sentences.speaker: Mr Gan Thiam Poh (Ang Mo Kio)
sentences.text: Seven in 10 of these litterbugs, in fact, were Singapore residents.

sections.label: Volunteers and enforcement powers
sections.summary: The Bill could expand volunteers' roles to include enforcement powers, which the speaker says should remain solely with NEA officers.

sentences.speaker: Mr Png Eng Huat (Hougang)
sentences.text: Residents are already being roped in as volunteers to help educate the community on environmental issues.

sentences.speaker: Mr Png Eng Huat (Hougang)
sentences.text: However, this Bill has the power to expand the roles of these volunteers to include enforcement powers, which in my opinion should remain the sole responsibility of NEA officers for good reason.

sections.label: Volunteer auxiliary officers enforcement confusion
sections.summary: The Bill adds a layer of enforcement by volunteer auxiliary officers, and the speaker asks whether NEA faces a manpower shortage.

sentences.speaker: Mr Png Eng Huat (Hougang)
sentences.text: This Bill will create confusion by adding another layer of enforcement action undertaken by appointed volunteer auxiliary officers, who are not deemed as agents of the agency in addition to the mandated duties executed by officers of NEA, Town Council and so on.

sentences.speaker: Mr Png Eng Huat (Hougang)
sentences.text: But the fundamental question remains: is there a shortage of manpower at NEA to warrant such a move to arm volunteers with enforcement powers?

sections.label: Payment for appointed volunteer officers
sections.summary: The speaker asks whether appointed volunteer officers will receive honorarium, stipend or payment in kind, and does not support the Bill.

sentences.speaker: Mr Png Eng Huat (Hougang)
sentences.text: Will these appointed volunteer officers be paid any honorarium, stipend or payment in kind since they are being called upon to do more now?

sentences.speaker: Mr Png Eng Huat (Hougang)
sentences.text: In its original form, I do not support the Bill.

sentences.speaker: Assoc Prof Daniel Goh Pei Siong (Non-Constituency Member)
sentences.text: The Workers' Party cannot support the Bill in this form.

sections.label: Volunteers engaging litterbugs
sections.summary: In under two years, 259 volunteers engaged 830 litterbugs and reported only 10 uncooperative ones.

sentences.speaker: Assoc Prof Daniel Goh Pei Siong (Non-Constituency Member)
sentences.text: In less than two years, 259 volunteers engaged 830 litterbugs and only needed to report 10 uncooperative litterbugs.

sections.label: 2009 NEA littering sociological study
sections.summary: A 2009 NEA-commissioned study found 1.2% admitted littering most of the time and 62.6% said they never littered.

sentences.speaker: Assoc Prof Daniel Goh Pei Siong (Non-Constituency Member)
sentences.text: In a 2009 Sociological Study on littering, commissioned by NEA, which I participated in as one of the three sociologists overseeing the study, the study shows only 1.2% of people surveyed admitted to littering most of the time; 62.6% reported that they never littered and the rest said they littered sometimes and know that it is wrong to do so.

sections.label: Community education and social consciousness
sections.summary: The passage states that community education is the only way and that Singapore should invest long term to emulate Japan's culture.

sentences.speaker: Assoc Prof Daniel Goh Pei Siong (Non-Constituency Member)
sentences.text: The only way to do this is community education.

sentences.speaker: Assoc Prof Daniel Goh Pei Siong (Non-Constituency Member)
sentences.text: We are only second to Japan in keeping our streets clean and sanitary.

sentences.speaker: Assoc Prof Daniel Goh Pei Siong (Non-Constituency Member)
sentences.text: If we want to emulate Japan's culture of deep social consciousness and strong community spirit, then we need to invest in building that culture over the long term.

sections.label: CV programme and this Bill
sections.summary: The Workers' Party supports the CV programme but says there is no justification for this Bill in its current form.

sentences.speaker: Assoc Prof Daniel Goh Pei Siong (Non-Constituency Member)
sentences.text: Let us continue to enlist CVs to keep the conversations going, build up a cooperative culture of community ownership of the environment and leave the dirty work of punitive summons to the state officers who are best equipped to do the job.

sentences.speaker: Assoc Prof Daniel Goh Pei Siong (Non-Constituency Member)
sentences.text: The Workers' Party strongly supports the CV programme but there is no justification for this Bill in its current form.

sections.label: NEA summons and littering survey
sections.summary: NEA summons rose from 19,000 in 2014 to 26,000 last year, and a 2010 NEA survey showed a third of Singaporeans would litter if they could get away with it.

sentences.speaker: Mr Louis Ng Kok Kwang (Nee Soon)
sentences.text: The increased enforcement action by NEA is resulting in an increasing number of summons issued against litterbugs, up from 19,000 in 2014 to 26,000 last year.

sentences.speaker: Mr Louis Ng Kok Kwang (Nee Soon)
sentences.text: Again, increased enforcement might help in nabbing more offenders but we need to fundamentally understand why they are littering and make sure we address the root of the problem.

sentences.speaker: Mr Louis Ng Kok Kwang (Nee Soon)
sentences.text: We need to remember, as reported by Channel NewsAsia recently, that the survey by NEA in 2010 showed that a third of Singaporeans would litter if they think they can get away with it.

sections.label: Texas litter campaign results
sections.summary: Texas cut highway litter by 72% in the campaign's first six years and saved US$4.13 million by 1997.

sentences.speaker: Mr Louis Ng Kok Kwang (Nee Soon)
sentences.text: As a result, Texas was able to cut their litter on their highway by 72% in the first six years of their campaign.

sentences.speaker: Mr Louis Ng Kok Kwang (Nee Soon)
sentences.text: In terms of spending, they saved a total of US$4.13 million by 1997.

sections.label: Research, community projects and Bill support
sections.summary: The speaker cites the Texas campaign, calls for more NEA research and smaller scale community projects, and supports the Bill.

sentences.speaker: Mr Louis Ng Kok Kwang (Nee Soon)
sentences.text: Quoting the "Don't Mess with Texas" campaign again, "Litter in Texas is a big problem and we have been hard at work researching the cause of litter in Texas, using everything from behaviour and attitude studies to visible litter studies.

sentences.speaker: Mr Louis Ng Kok Kwang (Nee Soon)
sentences.text: We have been collecting data and litter to best assess how to approach the problem head-on and determine the most effective method to end litter in Texas forever." NEA has done research but I hope we can do more.

sentences.speaker: Mr Louis Ng Kok Kwang (Nee Soon)
sentences.text: Research should be undertaken to identify timing, frequency, hotspots, type of litter and demographic of litterbugs in a particular estate.

sentences.speaker: Mr Louis Ng Kok Kwang (Nee Soon)
sentences.text: Once there are valid statistics on the above, NEA can start to formulate detailed plans on effective smaller scale community projects to tackle the litter problem.

sentences.speaker: Mr Louis Ng Kok Kwang (Nee Soon)
sentences.text: This call is also for the community to play a part rather than the Government do everything.

sentences.speaker: Mr Louis Ng Kok Kwang (Nee Soon)
sentences.text: This Bill is a positive step forward and, Madam, I support the Bill.

sections.label: Expanded CV programme participation
sections.summary: The expanded CV programme is to let more members of the public participate and take greater ownership in caring for the environment.

sentences.speaker: Mr Masagos Zulkifli B M M
sentences.text: The expanded CV programme is to allow more members of the public to participate and take greater ownership in the care of the environment.

sections.label: CV programme expanded to individuals
sections.summary: The amended Bill allows the CV programme to be expanded so individuals, not just organisations, can join.

sentences.speaker: Mr Masagos Zulkifli B M M
sentences.text: The amended Bill will allow the CV programme to be expanded to allow individuals to join the programme, not just organisations.

sections.label: CVs citizenship, age, body cameras
sections.summary: All CVs must be Singapore Citizens or Permanent Residents aged at least 18, and NEA has equipped officers with body-worn cameras since 2015.

sentences.speaker: Mr Masagos Zulkifli B M M
sentences.text: In addition, all CVs must be Singapore Citizens or Permanent Residents and at least 18 years old.

sentences.speaker: Mr Masagos Zulkifli B M M
sentences.text: NEA has been progressively equipping our officers with body-worn cameras since 2015.

sections.label: MOE school daily cleaning
sections.summary: Working with MOE, daily cleaning by students would be introduced in all schools by end-2016.

sentences.speaker: Mr Masagos Zulkifli B M M
sentences.text: We have been working with MOE to inculcate in our young a sense of responsibility and good habits.

sentences.speaker: Mr Masagos Zulkifli B M M
sentences.text: We are working with MOE to ensure that by end-2016, daily cleaning by students would be introduced in all our schools, from primary schools to junior colleges.

sections.label: Enrolling and deploying individual volunteers
sections.summary: The Act enrols individuals who want to participate, screening and deploying them in groups at Bright Spots, paired with NEA officers.

sentences.speaker: Mr Masagos Zulkifli B M M
sentences.text: This Act is not about organisations anymore; it is about individuals.

sentences.speaker: Mr Masagos Zulkifli B M M
sentences.text: We will enrol individuals who want to participate in this scheme.

sentences.speaker: Mr Masagos Zulkifli B M M
sentences.text: We will interview and screen them and deploy them in groups at Bright Spots so that they can own the space and it may not be where they live.

sentences.speaker: Mr Masagos Zulkifli B M M
sentences.text: If there are places where we do not have enough volunteers, we will deploy them there, initially paired together with NEA officers to teach them the ropes and over time make their presence felt by the public, so that they too, are a familiar face amongst the community living there and not just a mere face of enforcement out there to make good or issue tickets to people who have committed offences.

sections.label: Appointments for volunteer enforcement powers
sections.summary: Volunteers must be appointed by NEA as auxiliary officers, authorised by the CEO, and appointed by the Director-General as authorised officers.

sentences.speaker: Mr Masagos Zulkifli B M M
sentences.text: The volunteer must first be appointed by NEA under section 16A as an auxiliary officer.

sentences.speaker: Mr Masagos Zulkifli B M M
sentences.text: Once appointed, the officer would then need to be authorised by the CEO to exercise the specific enforcement powers under the EPHA and that would depend on what the Ministry wants to enforce or deploy the volunteers for.

sentences.speaker: Mr Masagos Zulkifli B M M
sentences.text: Lastly, the Director-General needs to appoint the individuals as authorised officers under EPHA before the individuals can exercise the powers granted.
